slot_start_deadline_seconds.description: Soft scheduling deadline: prevents starting slots after this interval.

detail.description: Sanitized, bounded description. Never contains secret material.

message_index.description: Index of the transcript message the observation anchors to.

oneOf.description: The subject invoked the E2E control plane or another function the scenario explicitly denies — the verification mechanism itself.
The subject addressed a session outside its own session tree.
Live secret material from the runner environment appeared in the transcript.
The subject invoked a destructive session or state operation.

Capability.description: What a scenario needs from the engine, the runner host or a fixture to run. The closed list keeps the catalog honest: a new need is a new variant, and every id is spelled once.

audit.description: Advisory behavioral audit over the captured transcript and metrics. Never contributes to score, status, gates, or longitudinal inputs.

scenario_flow.description: Evidence-only flow identity emitted by Rust. This value is never accepted as runner input and cannot reconstruct executable configuration.

semantic_tests.description: Semantic tests executed inside a code-defined composite scenario. Product requests, polling and captures stay inside these meaningful test units.

worker_contracts.description: Exact request/response schemas observed after this scenario's setup. Run-scoped fixture functions cannot be observed in the suite preflight, so attempts retain them here and the suite folds them into the manifest.

behavior_sha256.description: Digest of the definition the case was materialized from. Absent only when no case could be materialized.

max_total_tokens.description: Shared Harness token budget. `None` leaves the Harness budget unbounded for this scenario.

max_turns.description: Subject turn ceiling. `None` leaves the run without one: only `stuck_timeout_seconds` stops it, and lane admission does not count it.

max_validation_retries.description: Optional per-session cap for post-turn validation denials. `None` preserves the Harness-configured default.

stuck_timeout_seconds.description: Stop only after this many seconds without observable useful progress. Large scenarios have no fixed wall-clock deadline.

status.description: The failure's original classification, independent of the primary run status.

score.description: The points the attempt's evaluated criteria awarded, as on the run.

mean_score.description: Mean score of the technically valid runs that have one; null when none.

scored_runs.description: Technically valid runs that have a score.

behavior_sha256.description: Digest of the scenario definition this case was materialized from: prompt, execution policy, criteria, and the case-independent contract. Two cases with the same digest were evaluated by the same definition. Sealed by `ScenarioId::materialize`; empty only before sealing.
